verdicts.reason: A: the logo is moved to the left and blown up until it outweighs the quote. The opening quote mark floats far above the quote it belongs to. The quote is set small on one line that runs close to the right edge. The attribution is now bold and nearly as loud as the quote, so the original hierarchy is lost. B: the quote mark is shrunk to a speck. The quote's last word 'move.' nearly touches the 'MONOGRAPH' wordmark, a near-collision. The left third of the canvas is dead space, so the whole thing feels lopsided. The attribution is heavy and competes with the quote.
